name: v0.5.2
body:
**Container Image**: https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pkgs/container/praxis?tag=0.5.2

## Features

- **Prometheus metrics**: expand metrics surface (#794) by @henschwartz in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/825
- **Tracing**: wire tracing subscriber with fmt + OTLP layers by @Ladas in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/836
- **Random load balancing**: add random strategy by @eoinfennessy in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/888
- **Structured error responses**: pluggable error formatting by @leseb in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/891

## Bug Fixes

- **Security**: set H2 options on HttpProxy by @shaneutt
- **Security**: add basic-auth-filter to SECURITY_FILTERS by @shaneutt
- **Server**: filter config watcher events by file path by @leseb in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/890
- **Cleanup**: remove stale ext-proc references by @shaneutt

## Refactoring

- **TLS**: consolidate SNI server-name validation by @eoinfennessy in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/884
- **Protocol**: consolidate reserved header stripping by @s-akhtar-baig in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/892

## Documentation

- **Proposals**: add initial proposal for state by @shaneutt in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/852
- **Proposals**: add pipeline info admin endpoint proposal by @henschwartz in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/823
- **Proposals**: add How? for pipeline info admin endpoint (#796) by @henschwartz in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/899
- **Proposals**: add How? for expand Prometheus metrics surface (#794) by @henschwartz in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/898
- **Proposals**: add non-blocking log writer proposal by @henschwartz in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/921
- **Proposals**: add advanced retry policies by @abdallahsamabd in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/901
- **Proposals**: add sticky sessions by @abdallahsamabd in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/904
- **Proposals**: propose application-managed WebSocket sessions by @franciscojavierarceo in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/895

## Dependencies

- chore(deps): bump anthropics/claude-code-action from 1.0.180 to 1.0.183 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/886
- Multiple `cargo upgrade` rounds

## New Contributors

- @Ladas made their first contribution in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/836
- @s-akhtar-baig made their first contribution in https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/pull/892

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/praxis-proxy/praxis/compare/v0.5.1...v0.5.2
